title: A Zelle deposit for a copied video tour

source.name: FTC Consumer Advice, rental listing scams (pattern source; this example is fictional)

steps.label: Listing seen
steps.detail: A two-bedroom is listed well under the area's rents, with a video tour.

steps.label: Chat with the poster
steps.detail: The poster says they are out of the country and cannot show the place in person.

steps.label: Asked to pay to hold it
steps.detail: Another applicant is said to be ready, so the renter is asked to send a deposit to hold it.

steps.label: Paid by Zelle
steps.detail: The renter sends the deposit by Zelle before any viewing.

steps.label: Found out
steps.detail: The real tenant tells the renter the unit is occupied and was never for rent.

findings.text: The video tour was checked against the building's own scan.
Person not shown. The poster could not be matched to the building.
Zelle before a viewing. Red flag.
